article.title: New Flavors Announced
article.author: Myna Bird
article.featured_img_alt: A colorful selection of new ice cream flavors
article.content:
Our flavor team has been busy dreaming up three new reasons to visit Scoops and Smiles.

Look for Raspberry Ripple, Campfire Crunch, and Lemon Cookie Swirl in the dipping cabinet this week. Each flavor is available by the scoop, in a shake, or packed into a pint to take home.

Stop by for a sample and tell us which new flavor should earn a permanent place on the menu!
